Ileana praises the DualSense controller's **haptic feedback** feature on the PS5 for making switching between games smoother. The haptic feedback provides tactile sensations that correspond to different in-game actions and environments, enhancing the immersion and making transitions between games or activities feel more seamless. This feature allows players to feel different textures and impacts within the game, contributing to a more fluid and engaging experience when jumping from one game to another. The PS5's DualSense controller, with its advanced haptic feedback system, is one of the key hardware improvements that Sony introduced to enhance user interaction and experience on the console.
